rule: Each quarter shows the published medians before and with tax and rebates in effect at its end: the state after the last recorded refresh generated (UTC date) on or before the quarter's last day, the current quarter showing the latest recorded state as in progress; an unavailable level has no cost (a gap, never zero), and recording_gap marks a completed quarter whose next recorded refresh followed an unrecorded one (owner decisions 50, 55 and 57, 2026-11-23). break_before marks a change of the model's cost basis or of the level's example customer between two points, never a label-only or method-version-only change (owner decision 80, 2026-11-24), and a model removed and added again between them, whose earlier cost basis was not recorded (owner decision 84, 2026-11-24).
